about: Fifty sea creatures (tools/kitgen/sea.py): fishes, sharks and whales laid out by rule in Bestiary Forge's format. 'layout' is the forge's own placement list (centre parts on the spine, left parts mirrored by the page, fans as {array}); paste it into the forge or draw it with tools/kitgen/forge-render.mjs. 'parts' is the same creature as a kit recipe. Each passed the designed species' gate (round two) and fits the 400 x 400 frame. Names are working names.

plans.rule: A spindle: small head, pectorals, a pelvic pair, a forked tail.
A body under a mane of spines fanned on both flanks.
A round body, mostly mouth, a lure on a stalk over the head.
A slim body with two great pectoral wings held out.
Pointed snout, tapering body, swept pectorals, a long upper tail lobe.
A head that is a wide bar, the eyes at its ends.
A long saw for a snout, teeth along both edges.
A long body, long flippers forward, wide flat flukes.
A great block head a third of the whole, small flippers, flukes.
A whale with one long tusk held straight forward.
